item.title: [New] Windows at Ignite: IAKerb lets Windows 11 use Kerberos without line of sight to a DC, Windows Hello event logs record Face, Fingerprint or PIN unlocks, web sign-in reaches hybrid joined devices
item.description:
IAKerb removes a common reason Windows clients fall back to NTLM, and the new Windows Hello events give the SOC a record of how a device was unlocked; remote lock is a containment action that keeps the evidence on the disk.

Windows · Plan IAKerb into the NTLM-retirement work (audit NTLM use first), decide where the Windows Hello event logs will be collected, and add remote lock to the lost-device and compromised-device playbooks.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Sentinel at Ignite: ISOC opt-in for Sentinel customers with E5, E7 or Defender Suite from 17 November; audit logs for automation rules and playbooks (preview); ingest-time normalization (preview, December)
item.description:
A record of who changed an automation rule or playbook closes a gap an intruder with Sentinel Contributor could use to silence response; ISOC opt-in changes retention and cost, and normalization at ingest changes what parsers your rules depend on.

Sentinel · Turn on and export the automation-rule and playbook audit records, alert on deactivation or deletion of automation rules, and model the ISOC opt-in against current retention before deciding.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Intune at Ignite: software compliance policy marks devices running unsanctioned AI agents noncompliant for Conditional Access (preview); container policies for agents; vulnerability remediation agent (limited preview)
item.description:
Unapproved AI agents on endpoints become something compliance can block, and the remediation agent can patch devices automatically, so change records and alert baselines must expect agent-initiated patching.

Intune · Inventory AI agents on Windows endpoints with Defender, decide which MSI product codes to mark noncompliant, and pilot the software compliance policy in report-only Conditional Access first.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Exchange Online sending from aliases is generally available: users can send and reply from any proxy address once the tenant switch is on
item.description:
Once enabled, outbound mail can carry any proxy address of a mailbox, including onmicrosoft.com addresses, so detections and transport rules keyed to the primary SMTP address miss mail a compromised account sends from an alias.

Exchange Online · Check whether SendFromAliasEnabled is on, set onmicrosoft.com domains to SendingFromDomainDisabled, and review transport and journaling rules and sender-based detections for alias addresses.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Unified app and agent installation management is generally available: installs set in the Microsoft 365 or Teams admin center now sync to the other within 24-48 hours
item.description:
Which apps and agents are pushed to users is now decided in one place for Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 Copilot; an install policy changed in one admin center reaches the other without a second review.

M365 admin · Review installed-by-admin apps and agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center after unification, and restrict who holds the roles that can deploy agents.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Microsoft 365 Backup full workload backup: general availability slips from September-October 2026 to January-February 2027
item.description:
Ransomware recovery plans that counted on whole-workload backup at GA this autumn are three to four months early; until then only custom policies cover new sites and mailboxes.

M365 admin · Keep custom backup policies covering new sites and mailboxes until the GA lands, and move any recovery-plan dependency on full workload backup to Q1 2027.

item.description:

item.title: [New] Entra at Ignite: passkeys become the default for new accounts; PIM gains PIM-only mode, app roles and agents (preview); Conditional Access policy plans (preview); guest lifecycle policies GA
item.description:

Entra · Read the PIM-only mode and CA policy plan docs before enabling either; for guest lifecycle policies, run the built-in report in report mode first and warn sponsors.

item.title: [New] Hunt DCSync-style replication, GPO updates, LDAP searches and Kerberos binds in the identity tables of advanced hunting
item.description:

Defender XDR · Add a hunting query on IdentityDirectoryEvents for DRSR events whose source device is not a domain controller, and review existing LDAP reconnaissance detections against the new IdentityQueryEvents rows.

item.title: [New] Defender at Ignite: integrated SOC case management, playbooks, workbooks and UEBA are GA; vulnerability shielding (preview) is on by default
item.description:

item.title: [New] ASIM Email schema adds a third EventType, EmailInteraction
item.description:
Normalised email detections that filter on an exhaustive EventType list, or assume every row is a delivery or inspection, may miscount once parsers emit EmailInteraction rows.

Sentinel · Check custom ASIM email analytics rules for hard-coded EventType lists and decide whether user interactions (for example clicks) should be included.

item.title: [New] SCKit abuses ScreenConnect to install attacker-controlled remote access and steal MSP technician sessions (RelayTrap)
item.description:
An MSP or internal help desk that uses ScreenConnect is a trusted path into every managed device; a stolen technician session bypasses MFA on the RMM console and turns one compromise into many.

Threat Intel · Inventory ScreenConnect instances and extensions, update technician clients to 26.6.5 or later, run Microsoft's six hunting queries over the last 14 days, and revoke ScreenConnect web sessions and rotate technician credentials on any hit.

item.title: [New] Defender for Endpoint previews can now be switched on one at a time, and some scoped by safe deployment channel (preview)
item.description:
Preview sensor behaviour can now be limited to an early ring of devices instead of the whole estate, which lowers the risk of trying detection previews on servers and tier-0 hosts.

MDE · Review the preview features page in the Defender portal, keep previews off on domain controllers and other tier-0 devices, and pilot them on an early safe deployment channel.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Defender deployment tool gains embedded offboarding (preview): one key built into the tool offboards a device, silently with -Quiet
item.description:
Offboarding a sensor is how an intruder blinds MDE; a self-contained, silent offboarding binary is easier to misuse than a separate package file, so who can generate one and where it is stored now matters.

MDE · Restrict who holds the Defender role that can generate offboarding packages, set short expirations on any offboarding key you create, and alert on devices that stop reporting outside a change window.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Intune PowerShell script assignments stop applying while a targeted Entra group is soft-deleted
item.description:
Deleting a group silently stops hardening or remediation scripts from applying to its members; an intruder with group-admin rights could use that to strip a control without touching Intune.

Intune · Alert on deletion of groups used in Intune script or configuration assignments (AuditLogs: Delete group) and check assignment status for Soft-Deleted.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Intune maintenance window policies set when Windows update downloads, installs and restarts may start
item.description:
A maintenance window also bounds how fast an emergency security update lands; a narrow window on servers or kiosks delays patching of an exploited flaw.

Intune · If you adopt maintenance windows, document how an out-of-band security update overrides them and keep the window wide enough to meet your patch SLA.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] AgentIdUser.ReadWrite.All and .IdentityParentedBy now reach AI teammate creation in Microsoft's permission map; Perception permissions lose four session-message endpoints
item.description:
A delegated grant that already holds AgentIdUser.ReadWrite.* can now create AI teammates (agent identity users) with no new consent prompt.

Graph · List delegated grants of the two AgentIdUser permissions and watch the audit log for aiTeammate creation once the endpoint reaches the tenant.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Viva Engage stops creating Teams town hall events on 7 December 2026; organisers move to Engage events or Teams town halls
item.description:
No security effect; a change-management item for communications teams. Listed because Microsoft marks it a major retirement.

Viva · Tell event organisers and update internal guidance before 7 December; no security configuration changes.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Defender for Identity retires two classic alerts at the end of November: Remote code execution attempt and Suspected identity theft (pass-the-hash)
item.description:
Two identity-attack detections disappear from the SOC queue; any analytics rule, playbook or SLA keyed on their alert titles goes silent, and pass-the-hash on hosts without MDE is no longer alerted at all.

MDI · Before 30 November create the Advanced Hunting custom detection from Microsoft's RemoteCodeExecution query, confirm MDE covers every DC and tier-0 host for pass-the-hash, and repoint Sentinel rules and playbooks that match the two classic alert names.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Purview adaptive scopes lifecycle-status controls slip: preview to December 2026, general availability to April 2027
item.description:
A retention or DLP policy targeted with a new adaptive scope will silently stop covering inactive mailboxes and soft-deleted owners once the default lands, which matters for legal hold and leaver retention.

Purview · Note the new dates; before April 2027 decide whether retention scopes must include inactive and soft-deleted recipients and document it in the scope-creation runbook.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Blog] FinOps Blog: Your guide to FinOps for AI at Microsoft Ignite 2026
item.description:
AI has moved from pilots to production, and the questions have changed with it. It is no longer enough to know what AI costs. Lead…

item.title: [Message Center] MC1552397 Microsoft SharePoint: Resources web part and Announcements capabilities expand to all sites
item.description:
The Resources web part and Announcements capabilities are expanding to all SharePoint sites, allowing site owners to share links and updates more flexibly. Rollout starts mid-November 2026 worldwide and mid-December 2026 for GCC/DoD, with no admin action required.

SharePoint Online · stayInformed

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Message Center] MC1552394 Microsoft Viva Engage: Retirement of Teams town hall event creation
item.description:
Starting December 7, 2026, users cannot create Teams town hall events from Viva Engage; previously scheduled events will continue. Organizers must use the new Events experience in Viva Engage or Microsoft Teams. Organizations should inform teams and update documentation accordingly before this date.

Microsoft Viva · planForChange · act by 2026-12-07

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Message Center] MC1552392 Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording indicator for call queue calls on Mobile
item.description:
Microsoft Teams on Mobile will show a clear banner indicating automatic, uninterruptible recording and transcription of call queue calls by the organization. This update, rolling out worldwide in December 2026, aligns mobile with desktop and requires no admin action, though informing calling reps is recommended.

Microsoft Teams · stayInformed

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Message Center] MC1552391 Microsoft Teams: Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile
item.description:
Microsoft Teams is introducing Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile, allowing reps and supervisors to ask questions about recorded calls for quick insights. Rolling out worldwide from late November to mid-December 2026, it requires Teams Premium and Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses, with no admin action needed before rollout.

Microsoft Teams · stayInformed

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Message Center] MC1552390 Microsoft Teams: Manage call groups on Mobile
item.description:
Microsoft Teams will allow users to create and manage call groups directly on Mobile, enabling call forwarding and ring settings without desktop access. This feature, rolling out worldwide in December 2026, requires a Teams Phone license and enabled calling policy, with no admin action needed before rollout.

Microsoft Teams · stayInformed

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Message Center] MC1552389 Microsoft 365 Copilot: Workforce Intelligence plugin available in Copilot Cowork
item.description:
The Workforce Intelligence plugin in Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork, launching November 16, 2026, helps leaders explore organizational structure and skills via natural language. It respects existing data permissions, supports team learning, requires admin setup, and is not for employee evaluation or performance management.

Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) · Stay Informed

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Message Center] MC1552387 Retired: Microsoft Defender for Identity classic alerts (Remote code execution attempt and pass-the-hash)
item.description:
Microsoft Defender for Identity will retire two classic alerts—Remote code execution attempt and pass-the-hash—by late November 2026. Users should create custom detection rules for RCE and rely on Defender for Endpoint for pass-the-hash monitoring. No compliance issues are identified.

Microsoft Defender XDR · planForChange · act by 2026-11-30

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Message Center] MC1552386 Microsoft 365 Copilot: Page context for open tabs in the Copilot desktop app built-in browser
item.description:
Microsoft 365 Copilot desktop app will use content from open tabs in its built-in browser as page context for answering questions and summaries, scoped to the current conversation. Rolling out worldwide mid to late November 2026. No action required; verify browser enablement and governance settings.

Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) · Stay Informed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1551151 Microsoft Entra ID: Risk-based anti-bot verification (CAPTCHA) for SMS and voice multi-factor authentication
item.description:
Starting mid-November 2026, Microsoft Entra ID will add risk-based CAPTCHA verification for SMS and voice MFA to prevent automated fraud. Some users may need to complete CAPTCHA before receiving codes or calls. Administrators should prepare users, ensure network readiness, and promote phishing-resistant methods.

Microsoft Entra · preventOrFixIssue

item.title: [Message Center] MC1551148 [Outlook for iOS and Android] Copilot Chat in Outlook UX improvements
item.description:
Copilot Chat in Outlook for iOS and Android is being updated with a refreshed, consistent design across Microsoft 365 apps, improved chat interface, prompts, and navigation. Rollout starts mid-December 2026, completing by late January 2027. No admin action or compliance concerns are required.

Exchange Online · stayInformed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1551147 Microsoft Word: Retirement of legacy compatibility settings
item.description:
Microsoft Word will retire legacy compatibility settings for documents in Compatibility Mode starting December 2026 (Windows) and early 2027 (Mac). This may cause layout changes in older documents. No action is required, but review important documents if exact layout is critical.

Microsoft 365 apps · planForChange

item.title: [New] Graph permissions sync of 13 November: NetworkAccess.Read.All and .ReadWrite.All reach the Global Secure Access IDPS policies; CopilotCostManagement.Read.All gains spending policies
item.description:
An app already holding NetworkAccess.ReadWrite.All can now edit or delete intrusion-detection (IDPS) policies in Global Secure Access with no new consent prompt; CopilotCostManagement.Read.All now exposes identities, not just totals.

Graph · List service principals holding NetworkAccess.ReadWrite.All and CopilotCostManagement.Read.All and confirm the reach is intended.

item.title: [New] Out-of-band Windows update fixes SLMGR licensing and KMS activation failures (error 0x80041008) caused by the November 2026 security update
item.description:
Scripted KMS and product-key provisioning breaks on freshly built or re-imaged servers, so new hosts can come up unactivated; it is a reliability fault in the November patch, not a vulnerability.

Windows · If build or activation scripts call slmgr.vbs and failed after the November update, import the matching OOB KB from the Microsoft Update Catalog; no action for devices that are already activated.

item.title: [New] Windows 10 Enterprise LTSC 2021 ends mainstream support on 13 January 2027 (60-day reminder) - the 90-day reminder MC1507706 said 12 January
item.description:
LTSC 2021 sits on kiosks, OT jump hosts and specialised devices that are easy to forget; without ESU they stop receiving security fixes after January 2027.

Windows · Inventory Windows 10 Enterprise LTSC 2021 devices and decide per device between Windows 11 Enterprise LTSC 2024 and ESU before the January 2027 update.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Windows Server 2016 ends extended support on 13 January 2027 (60-day reminder) - the 90-day reminder MC1507705 said 12 January
item.description:
Unpatched Windows Server 2016 domain controllers, AD FS, AD CS or Entra Connect hosts become a permanent tier-0 exposure from February 2027 unless enrolled in ESU.

Windows Server · List every Windows Server 2016 host, starting with domain controllers and identity servers, and either migrate it or enrol it in ESU before the January 2027 update.

item.title: [New] Entra adds a risk-based CAPTCHA before some SMS and voice MFA codes and calls from mid-November; restrictive firewalls can stop the prompt loading
item.description:
A sign-in that cannot load the CAPTCHA fails MFA, so help-desk tickets and sign-in failures from locked-down networks will rise; telephony MFA fraud (toll fraud, automated pumping) is the threat it targets.

Entra · Brief the help desk, check that proxies and web filters let the Entra verification resources load during sign-in, and keep moving users from SMS and voice to passkeys.

item.title: [New] SharePoint temporary-authentication (tempauth) URLs retire on 1 April 2027; Power Apps and flows that hand out pre-authenticated SharePoint links break
item.description:

Power Platform · Inventory custom Power Platform controls, actions and connectors that return or consume SharePoint tempauth URLs and move them to Entra ID tokens before 1 April 2027.

item.title: [New] Microsoft's 12 November Graph permission sync maps Teams chat message replies to nine Chat and ChatMessage permissions and drops two account-takeover-protection endpoints
item.description:
Threaded replies in Teams chats become reachable through permissions apps already hold, so any app with chat read access can read reply content and inline images without a new consent prompt.

Graph · List apps granted Chat.*.All or ChatMessage.Read.All and confirm their owners expect reply content; keep MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs queries for /chats/ calls broad enough to match /replies.

item.title: [New] ReFS on removable media: audit phase since the October 2026 update, blocking becomes the default with the January 2027 Windows security update
item.description:
Removable ReFS volumes are an unsupported, attacker-reachable file-system surface; the audit events list where blocking will break something in January.

Windows · Collect the ReFS audit events for removable media now, migrate the workflows they show, and enable blocking in a test ring before the January 2027 update makes it the default.

item.description:

item.title: [New] Custom authentication strengths that allow SMS or voice but not passkeys will block sign-in when SMS and voice retire: from 1 February 2027 for users, from 1 July 2027 for Global Administrators and external users
item.description:
A Conditional Access policy that requires a custom authentication strength without passkeys turns the SMS/voice retirement into a hard sign-in block, including for Global Administrators from 1 July 2027.

Entra · List custom authentication strengths that allow SMS or voice, add passkeys (FIDO2) to each, and check which Conditional Access policies (break-glass and admin policies first) require them, before 1 February 2027.

item.title: [New] Scheduled prompts in Microsoft 365 Copilot move from Power Platform to native Copilot scheduling; the Power Platform-based experience retires on 31 December 2026
item.description:
Unattended Copilot runs no longer pass through Power Platform, so a tenant that relied on disabling Power Automate to stop scheduled Copilot tasks loses that control.

Copilot · Before 31 December 2026, tell users who rely on scheduled prompts to recreate schedules that do not migrate, and review which Copilot controls now govern unattended scheduled tasks.
